summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (test_set_window_title), tests/test_control.py (test_control_title), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (test_control_set_window_title). Not run: per instructions, no tests, scripts, or installs were executed, and mypy was not run for the widened union. Nothing committed.
